title: fix(play): the progress bar skips from 9 to Results
body:
**Size:** S

On the tenth question `components/RoundProgress.tsx` still shows 9 filled steps when Results takes over, so the bar never reads 10 of 10.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The bar shows 10 of 10 for the last question's verdict, on every level
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
why: An open PR already carries the work: the skill reuses its branch and makes no second one.
